related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

request.operation: inspect the identity and output provenance of the environmental-capability projection

outcome.observed_limitation: The projection identity was derived from selected source context and state digests, but the returned interpretation had no content fingerprint. A projection implementation change could therefore alter conclusions while preserving the same source-context identity.
outcome.interpretation: This is an output traceability and accountability gap. It does not establish that the projection's pressure analysis was incorrect or that agents experienced measurable intervention burden.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A stable source-context identity did not distinguish changed environmental-capability interpretations
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: mncs-environment capability-intelligence projection identity and response budgeting
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Keep the source-context identity stable and add a content fingerprint for each returned interpretation, including compact responses, within the existing output budget.

not_measured: whether later agents use the content fingerprint to distinguish interpretation changes
whether this traceability gap caused duplicated investigation or other measurable intervention
whether changed interpretations improve service correctness or agent outcomes
measurement_limits: One selected session and projection context are represented; cross-session recurrence is not established.
The source identity remains a context correlation key and is not evidence of projection correctness.
